question: In November 2021, the Union Ministry of Cooperation launched the "Dairy Sahakar" scheme at Anand, Gujarat at an outlay of ₹________ crores.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5,000.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **"Dairy Sahakar" program** was introduced by the **Union Minister of Home Affairs** and **Corporation in Anand, Gujarat.**
 
• **NCDC**, which falls under the **Ministry of Cooperation**, will implement the** Dairy Sahakar.**
 
• Total investment of **Rs 5000 crore** is done.
 
• Realizing the vision of** "from cooperation to wealth"** is the goal.
 
• NCDC will provide** eligible cooperatives** participating in the program with **financial support **for things like** bovine development, milk procurement, processing, quality assurance, value addition, branding, packaging, marketing, transportation, and storage of milk and milk products**, as well as exports of dairy products.
 
• The overall goal is of **"Doubling the Farmer's Income." **and** "Bharat Atmanirbhar.**
 
• The program will support the **country's ongoing efforts** to boost the dairy industry. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Livestock Mission:**

 
 
• The **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare** is behind the project.
 
• It was introduced in **2014-15.**
 
• Its goal is the** livestock industry's sustainable development.**
 
• From** 2014–15 to 2019–20**, the country's livestock industry grew at a **compound annual growth rate of 8.15%.**
